review_method: assistant direct view of four full extracted 1280x720 PNG frames only
observations: All four sampled frames show the CK3 map battle marker and bottom battle display.

The 23.233 s sample shows the pause label and a right-side notification overlay.
The displayed game date advances from March 24 to March 29, and the battle display's troop figures change between the sampled endpoints.
